params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} Nearby allied champions gain {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while moving toward {{ci|Janna}}.
params.blurb2: Her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Zephyr|Janna}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to a portion of her {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Janna''' grants {{sti|ms|{{as|6% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} to nearby allied {{tip|champions}} that are facing in the direction of her location.
params.description2: '''Janna's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Zephyr|Janna}}'' deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|30% of her '''bonus''' movement speed}}.

blurb.plain: Innate: Nearby allied champions gain bonus movement speed while moving toward Janna.

blurb2.plain: Her basic attacks and Zephyr deal bonus magic damage equal to a portion of her bonus movement speed.

description.plain: Innate: Janna grants 6% bonus movement speed to nearby allied champions that are facing in the direction of her location.

description2.plain: Janna's basic attacks on-hit and Zephyr deal bonus magic damage equal to 30% of her bonus movement speed.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Janna}} summons a whirlwind at her current location that matures over a short time, increasing its range, speed, damage, and knock up duration.
params.blurb2: ''Howling Gale'' can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} The whirlwind flies in the target direction over a short time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies hit. The effects are increased based on maturity.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and {{tip|airborne|knock up}} duration every second over the duration. ''Howling Gale's'' direction is determined by this cast.
params.description2: ''Howling Gale'' can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
params.leveling:
{{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 195}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Damage Per Second|{{ap|10 to 30}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|55+10*3 to 195+30*3}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}}}}
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Janna''' launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{pp|type=seconds charged|0.5 to 1.25|0 to 1.5 by 0.1}} seconds.
params.range: {{pp|type=seconds charged|1100 to 1000*1.76|0 to 3 by 1|changedisplay=true|formula=Increases by 22 every 0.1 seconds.}}
params.speed: {{pp|type=seconds charged|(880 to 1408)|0 to 3 by 1|changedisplay=true|formula  = Always travels for 1.25 seconds.}}
params.notes:
* The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The storm does not interact with enemy units that stand on top of it while it is charging.

blurb.plain: Active: Janna summons a whirlwind at her current location that matures over a short time, increasing its range, speed, damage, and knock up duration.

blurb2.plain: Howling Gale can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.

blurb3.plain: Recast: The whirlwind flies in the target direction over a short time, dealing magic damage and knocking up enemies hit. The effects are increased based on maturity.

description.plain: Active: Janna summons a whirlwind at her current location that charges up over 3 seconds, increasing its range, speed, damage, and knock up duration every second over the duration. Howling Gale's direction is determined by this cast.

description2.plain: Howling Gale can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.

description3.plain: Recast: Janna launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over 1.25 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for 0.5 – 1.25 (based on seconds charged) seconds.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Janna}} gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and becomes permanently {{tip|ghosted}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' sends an air elemental to the target enemy, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 175}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' movement speed)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 36}}% {{as|(+ 6% per 100 AP)}}}}
params.notes:
* The maximum slow (99%) is reached with {{ap|(99-20)*100/6 to (99-36)*100/6|round=2}} ability power.
{{Unit-targeted cancel conditions}}

blurb.plain: Passive: Janna gains bonus movement speed and becomes permanently ghosted.

blurb2.plain: Active: Janna sends an air elemental to the target enemy, dealing magic damage and slowing them.

description.plain: Passive: Janna is ghosted and gains bonus movement speed.

description2.plain: Active: Janna sends an air elemental at the target enemy that deals magic damage and slows them for 2 seconds, capped at 99%.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever {{cis|Janna}} abilities {{tip|slow}} or {{tip|airborne|knock up}} at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, she {{sti|cdr|refunds}} a portion of {{ais|Eye of the Storm|Janna}} cooldown.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' can target an allied champion, {{tip|turret}}, or herself to place a {{tip|shield}} that decays over a short time.
params.blurb3: While the shield holds, the target gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Janna's''' abilities {{tip|slow}} or {{tip|airborne|knock up}} at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}, 20% of ''Eye of the Storm's'' cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' grants the target allied champion or {{tip|turret}}, or herself, a {{tip|shield}} for 4 seconds.
params.description3: While the shield holds, the target gains {{sti|attack damage|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
params.notes:
* ''Eye of the Storm'' has a {{tip|forgiveness radius}} of 175 units.
* '''Janna''' receives kill credit on enemy champions that are killed by turrets shielded by ''Eye of the Storm''.
* Allied turrets will benefit from the bonus attack damage when targeted by ''Eye of the Storm''.

blurb.plain: Passive: Whenever Janna abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, she refunds a portion of Eye of the Storm cooldown.

blurb2.plain: Active: Janna can target an allied champion, turret, or herself to place a shield that decays over a short time.

blurb3.plain: While the shield holds, the target gains bonus attack damage.

description.plain: Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.

description2.plain: Active: Janna grants the target allied champion or turret, or herself, a shield for 4 seconds.

description3.plain: While the shield holds, the target gains bonus attack damage.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Janna}} unleashes a blast that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} nearby enemies, though not through terrain.
params.blurb2: She also {{tip|channels}} the winds for a short time, continually {{tip|heal|healing}} nearby allies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Janna''' unleashes a blast that {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over {{fd|0.5}} seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain.
params.description2: '''Janna''' also {{tip|channel|channels}} for up to 3 seconds, {{tip|heal|healing}} herself and nearby allies every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|700|Both knockback and healing zone radius}}

blurb.plain: Active: Janna unleashes a blast that knocks back nearby enemies, though not through terrain.

blurb2.plain: She also channels the winds for a short time, continually healing nearby allies.

description.plain: Active: Janna unleashes a blast that knocks back all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over 0.5 seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain.

description2.plain: Janna also channels for up to 3 seconds, healing herself and nearby allies every 0.25 seconds.
